name: Whirlpool TL DD Inlet Valve Coil Resistance (J2)
purpose: All solenoid coils on J2 valve harness — common J2-4 (White) to valve pin.
failureModes: Open coil — no fill on that leg (F8E1 / LF)
Out of range — replace valve assembly
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #2 — Fabric Softener J2-4&7, Hot J2-4&9, Cold J2-4&10, Detergent J2-4&11, Fresh Fill J2-4&12
Live valve test via Service Test Mode function numbers 001–004

name: Whirlpool TL DD Motor Winding Resistance (J1)
purpose: Direct-drive BPM stator at ACU J1 and motor connector — pairs 1-3 and 3-4.
failureModes: Open winding — F7E6 motor circuit open
Very low — shorted stator (F7E3 over current)
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #3b — measure at J1 then at drive motor connector 2-3 and 3-4
Locked rotor F7E9 — check impeller/basket friction before replacing drive

name: Whirlpool TL DD Drain Pump Resistance (J4)
purpose: Drain pump winding at J4-1 (Neutral) and J4-3 (Drain Pump).
failureModes: Open — F9E1 / dr long drain
Good ohms but no run — ACU relay or obstruction
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #7 — also verify at pump terminals after harness check
Service Test Mode drain pump toggle before bench ohms

name: Whirlpool TL DD Recirculation Pump Resistance (J4)
purpose: Recirc pump winding at J4-1 and J4-5 (not on all models).
failureModes: Open — no recirculation
Obstruction at tub sump under impeller
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #7 — recirc models only
Service Test Mode recirc function before replacement

name: Whirlpool TL DD Lid Lock Motor Winding (J6)
purpose: Lid lock motor winding J6-2 to J6-3 — 35 Ω ±5 per OEM table.
failureModes: Open motor — F5E2 lock failure
Switch state wrong — replace lid lock mechanism
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #8 — also verify Home/Lock/Lid switch states at J6
Lid lock Service Test Mode before bench diagnosis

name: Whirlpool TL DD Inlet Water Thermistor (J2)
purpose: Inlet thermistor at J2-1 (Rtn) and J2-2 — 10 kΩ @ 77°F (25°C); OEM R/T table to 149°F.
failureModes: Open or short — F3E2 inlet water temperature fault
In range at valve but fault persists — replace ACU
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #5 — measure at ambient; compare to OEM kΩ table
Thermistor is part of valve assembly — replace valve when out of range

name: Whirlpool TL DD Tub Heater Resistance
purpose: Tub heater element — OEM abnormal = infinite (open).
failureModes: Open heater — F4E2 heater not turning on
Relay stuck — F4E1 heater stuck on
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #9 — heater on some models only
Service Test Mode function 017 toggle with water above impeller

name: Whirlpool TL DD Bulk Dispense Pump Resistance
purpose: Bulk dispense pump at extension harness — 1485–1815 Ω.
failureModes: Open pump — F3E4 bulk dispense fault with REX comm issue
Good ohms but no flow — REX board or hoses
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #12 — verify J7 ACU↔REX and Rex J1–J3 first
Service Test Mode function 018 — detergent trickle after ~2 min

name: Whirlpool TL DD UI +5 VDC at J18
purpose: UI supply at ACU J18-1 (+5 VDC) to J18-3 (Circuit Gnd) — diagnostic LED troubleshooting.
failureModes: Missing +5 VDC with LED off — ACU or UI harness
LED on steady — micro failure on ACU
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #1 step 8 — disconnect J18 to isolate UI load
Do not short pins; use needle probes with connectors seated for other live checks

name: Whirlpool TL DD Basket Light Drive Voltage (J19)
purpose: Basket light control at J19 — ~0.13 V lid closed; 2.8–5.0 V lid open.
failureModes: Correct ACU voltage but no light — replace basket light
Wrong voltage — replace ACU
testingTips: W10864849 TEST #11 — measure J19-1 (+) to J19-2 (−) with lid open and closed
Basket light on some models only
